Line Rokkedal Jønsson is a development physiotherapist who holds a Master of Science in Physiotherapy [^src1]. She is professionally based at Amager and Hvidovre Hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) and represents the Danish Society for Physiotherapy [^src1]. 

Her primary significance in the context of the 2023 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database (AKDB) is her role as a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]] [^src1]. As part of the database's governance under the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP), her position on the steering committee highlights the interdisciplinary and cross-regional structure that oversees the database [^src1]. Through this role, Jønsson helps integrate specialized physiotherapeutic expertise into the evaluation and management of acute surgical quality measurements and clinical indicators across Denmark's five regions [^src1].
